description: Executed by the Renovate GitHub App installed on this repository; there is no workflow in .github/ that runs it. Dependabot keeps github-actions and npm (.github/dependabot.yml).

customManagers.description: `.go-version` is a bare version string with no manager of its own. `golang-version` tracks upstream Go releases and is the datasource the built-in gomod manager uses for the toolchain directive.

go.mod's `go` directive states the same toolchain version, and check-base-image-version-consistency.sh holds it to .go-version. Matched by regex so the directive alone is in scope; the gomod manager would bring every module dependency with it.

packageRules.description: Base images are referenced as tag@digest (VEC-783); pinDigests keeps new and unpinned references that way.
The Go toolchain is written in .go-version, in Dockerfile.common, in go.mod and in the devcontainer image; grouping them puts the bump in one branch so it lands as a single commit.
Python is written in .python-version and in python/Dockerfile's py-base stage; grouped for the same reason.
Node is written in .node-version and in python/Dockerfile's ui-builder stage; grouped for the same reason. The tag there must stay a full patch version for the check to compare it.
A major is a migration, not a bump. Majors wait behind an explicit tick on the dependency dashboard; closing one there keeps it closed without blocking the minor and patch updates underneath it.
